title: How to do a Baton Twirling Fan for Novice/Beginners | Starting Baton Twirling Tutorial #1

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the baton twirling move into component parts and demonstrates form clearly. She uses close-up shots of hands and wrist movement to illustrate technique.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the tutorial
Explaining the ball and tip of the baton
Starting position and large circle motion
Detailed wrist motion for the fan
Using the other hand to guide and practice the motion

cues: focus on doing the motion with your wrist

steps_taught.name: Fan motion
steps_taught.description: Taking the ball of the baton down past your elbow and back up using wrist motion

what_works: breaking down the motion step by step
what_hinders: lack of counting or tempo breakdown

quotes.text: To start, you have a small and big side of the baton
You want to start by having the ball of the baton facing downwards
This is how you do the fan motion

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher shows close-up of baton ends labeling ball and tip
Demonstrating wrist and arm motion for the fan pattern

extraction.distinctive_method: Using the opposite hand to physically guide the twirling arm through the correct motion pathway
